environment.description: ASP.NET Core 8.0 application deployed on a standard Ubuntu 22.04 VM via systemd service unit. Process runs as 'app' user with standard filesystem access. Container runtime: none. The application listens on port 5000 behind an nginx reverse proxy that only performs TLS termination and header forwarding. No serialization binder configured. BinaryFormatter is enabled via runtimeconfig.json setting 'System.Runtime.Serialization.EnableUnsafeBinaryFormatterSerialization=true'.

config.filesystem: full read access to /etc, /proc, /home; write to /opt/workflow-engine
